subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I _________ such an incredible opportunity because of you.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"missed" **is the most appropriate choice to complete the sentence.
 
• The other options (kicked, blanked, loosed) do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence implies that the speaker lost an opportunity because of someone, making **"missed"** the correct word to use.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I **missed **such an incredible opportunity because of you."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kicked:** This word does not fit the context of the sentence as it usually implies a physical action or an idiomatic expression.
 
• **Blanked:** This word typically means to forget or fail to remember, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Loosed:** This word means to set free or release, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
